index 0000000..8670b72
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/reusebench_click_summary/steps.py
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+from click.utils import make_default_short_help
+
+
+def prepare(record: dict) -> dict:
+    """Validate a record and derive its short display text."""
+    if not isinstance(record, dict) or "value" not in record:
+        raise ValueError("record must be a dict with a key and value")
+
+    key = record.get("key")
+    if not isinstance(key, str) or not (key := key.strip()):
+        raise ValueError("record key must be a nonempty string")
+
+    enabled = record.get("enabled", True)
+    if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+        raise ValueError("enabled must be a bool")
+
+    value = record["value"]
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise ValueError("record value must be a string")
+
+    return {
+        "key": key,
+        "value": value,
+        "display": make_default_short_help(value, max_length=20),
+        "enabled": enabled,
+    }

diff --git a/src/reusebench_click_summary/steps.py b/src/reusebench_click_summary/steps.py
index 8670b72..a8d8d79 100644
--- a/src/reusebench_click_summary/steps.py
+++ b/src/reusebench_click_summary/steps.py
@@ -24,3 +24,20 @@ def prepare(record: dict) -> dict:
         "display": make_default_short_help(value, max_length=20),
         "enabled": enabled,
     }
+
+
+def batch(records: list) -> list[dict]:
+    """Prepare records in order, rejecting duplicate normalized keys."""
+    if not isinstance(records, list):
+        raise ValueError("records must be a list")
+
+    prepared = []
+    seen = set()
+    for record in records:
+        item = prepare(record)
+        key = item["key"]
+        if key in seen:
+            raise ValueError(f"duplicate key: {key!r}")
+        seen.add(key)
+        prepared.append(item)
+    return prepared

diff --git a/src/reusebench_click_summary/steps.py b/src/reusebench_click_summary/steps.py
index a8d8d79..e96614c 100644

+++ b/src/reusebench_click_summary/steps.py
@@ -41,3 +41,12 @@ def batch(records: list) -> list[dict]:
         seen.add(key)
         prepared.append(item)
     return prepared
+
+
+def group(records: list) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
+    """Group enabled display strings by the first character of their key."""
+    groups = {}
+    for item in batch(records):
+        if item["enabled"]:
+            groups.setdefault(item["key"][0], []).append(item["display"])
+    return groups

     return groups
+
+
+def merge(left: list, right: list) -> list[dict]:
+    """Merge prepared records, replacing shared keys without moving them."""
+    merged = {item["key"]: item for item in batch(left)}
+    merged.update((item["key"], item) for item in batch(right))
+    return list(merged.values())
